id: 01_Safety Quiz Questions & Answers Safety Quiz Competition Safety Quiz For Safety O
title: 安全日知识竞赛：二十道综合安全题
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/01_Safety Quiz Questions & Answers Safety Quiz Competition Safety Quiz For Safety O.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/01_Safety Quiz Questions & Answers Safety Quiz Competition Safety Quiz For Safety O/src.py

points.K1: 测验规则：先做再对答案
points.K6: 职业健康安全管理体系
points.K20: 空调不含消耗臭氧层物质
points.K22: 化学品安全技术说明书
points.S2: 实验室里的有毒窒息性气体

shots.scene: 欣欣站在问答台后，台上有抢答铃，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a quiz podium with a buzzer on it and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 安全日到了，我们来办知识竞赛！
overlay: 安全日知识竞赛：二十道综合安全题

shots.scene: 一排图标：汽车、警铃、心形、火焰、电插头、垃圾桶、化学品瓶
shots.prompt_en: A row of simple icons: a car, an alarm bell, a heart, a flame, a power plug, a waste bin and a chemical bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 交通、疏散、急救、消防、环保，样样都有。

shots.scene: 阿杰在实验楼大厅看到竞赛海报，挠头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at a blank quiz competition poster in a laboratory building lobby and scratches his head.
shots.narration: 阿杰嘀咕：这些常识，跟实验室有关吗？

shots.scene: 小研笑着拍拍他，指向实验室门
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student smiles, pats the young male student on the shoulder and points to a laboratory door.
shots.narration: 小研说：每道题，都能在实验室找到影子。

shots.scene: 王老师抱着一叠空白答题卡走来
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks in carrying a stack of blank answer cards.
shots.narration: 王老师来当裁判，竞赛开始。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：先做再对答案
shots.scene: 欣欣举起一张空白答题卡，旁边浮现题数与分值图示
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank answer card; beside it float simple number blocks and a progress bar. No text.
shots.narration: 一共二十题，每题五分，满分一百。
overlay: 测验规则：先做再对答案

shots.section_title: 测验规则：先做再对答案
shots.scene: 一个进度条在八成处画一面小旗
shots.prompt_en: A long progress bar with a small flag planted at four fifths of its length. No people.
shots.narration: 答对八成，就算及格。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：先做再对答案
shots.scene: 阿杰捂住答案页，自己在答题卡上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student covers an answer sheet with one hand and ticks boxes on a blank answer card with the other.
shots.narration: 先别看答案，自己做一遍。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：先做再对答案
shots.scene: 阿杰对照答案，数着打勾的数量
shots.prompt_en: The young male student compares his card with an answer sheet and counts the ticks with his finger.
shots.narration: 做完再核对，看自己答对了几题。

shots.scene: 四张桌子，各坐一队，桌上立着A、B、C、D小旗图标
shots.prompt_en: Four tables in a hall, each with a small team of students and a small colored flag on it. No text.
shots.narration: 把大家分成四队，各占一张桌。

shots.scene: 一个纸箱里放着折好的纸签，阿杰伸手抽签
shots.prompt_en: The young male student draws a folded paper slip from a small box full of folded blank slips.
shots.narration: 每队轮流抽签，签上是题号。

shots.scene: 王老师在白板上给队伍加分
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator adds marks next to team flags on a blank whiteboard with a marker.
shots.narration: 答对加五分，答错不得分。

shots.scene: 白板上四根柱子高低不同，一队胜出举杯
shots.prompt_en: A blank whiteboard with four bars of different heights; one team raises a small trophy happily.
shots.narration: 最后比总分，得分最高的队获胜。

shots.scene: 汽车排气管冒出灰色烟雾，旁边四个气体分子图标
shots.prompt_en: A car exhaust pipe releasing gray fumes, with four different simple gas molecule icons floating beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：汽车尾气里，哪种气体最伤人？

shots.scene: 一个分子图标亮起，配骷髅警示图标
shots.prompt_en: One molecule icon glows brightly next to a skull warning pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是一氧化碳。

shots.scene: 血液中的红细胞图标被灰色小球占据
shots.prompt_en: Simple red blood cell icons being blocked by small gray balls, a faded oxygen icon nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 它无色无味，会让血液带不了氧。

shots.scene: 车库里一辆车发动着，门关着，画红叉
shots.prompt_en: A car running inside a closed garage with a red X over the scene. No people.
shots.narration: 所以别在封闭空间里发动车辆。

shots.section_title: 实验室里的有毒窒息性气体
shots.scene: 实验室角落一排气瓶，被固定在架子上
shots.prompt_en: A row of gas cylinders chained securely to a wall rack in a laboratory corner. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里，也有一氧化碳这类气体。
overlay: 实验室里的有毒窒息性气体

shots.section_title: 实验室里的有毒窒息性气体
shots.scene: 墙上的气体报警器图标亮着绿灯，通风口有气流线
shots.prompt_en: A wall-mounted gas detector with a green light and airflow lines near a ventilation vent. No people.
shots.narration: 用气要有通风，按规定装气体报警器。

shots.section_title: 实验室里的有毒窒息性气体
shots.scene: 老李检查气瓶阀门和管路接头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks a gas cylinder valve and tubing joints with a leak detection brush.
shots.narration: 管路接头定期检漏，用完关阀。

shots.section_title: 实验室里的有毒窒息性气体
shots.scene: 小研闻到异常后立即离开房间，向外打电话
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leaves a lab room quickly, covering her nose, and makes a phone call in the corridor.
shots.narration: 报警器响或觉得头晕，先撤离再报告。

shots.scene: 汽车驾驶座视角，四个小图标：杯子、说话气泡、眼睛看路、收音机
shots.prompt_en: A car driver's seat view with four small icons: a drink cup, a speech bubble, an eye looking at the road and a radio dial. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：哪一项不算驾驶分心？

shots.scene: 杯子、说话气泡、收音机三个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The drink cup, speech bubble and radio icons are each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 边吃喝、聊天、调收音机，都是分心。

shots.scene: 眼睛看路的图标打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The eye-on-the-road icon gets a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 盯着前方路面，才是正确的驾驶。

shots.scene: 阿杰在实验台前把手机放进抽屉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts his phone into a drawer before starting work at a lab bench.
shots.narration: 做实验也一样，别一边看手机一边操作。

shots.scene: 走廊里警铃闪烁，几个人回头张望
shots.prompt_en: An alarm bell flashing in a corridor; a few students turn their heads in surprise.
shots.narration: 第三题：疏散演练，警报响了怎么办？

shots.scene: 关电脑、去叫同事、坐等广播三个图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons crossed out with red X marks: a computer being shut down, a person calling a colleague and a waiting loudspeaker. No people.
shots.narration: 不先关电脑，不等广播，不磨蹭。

shots.scene: 学生们沿着绿色箭头快步走向安全出口
shots.prompt_en: Students walk briskly along green arrows toward an emergency exit sign.
shots.narration: 听到警报，立即疏散。

shots.scene: 墙上的疏散路线图，标出两个出口和集合点
shots.prompt_en: A blank evacuation floor plan on a wall showing two exit arrows and an assembly point icon. No people.
shots.narration: 平时就要认清疏散路线和集合点。

shots.scene: 电梯图标打叉，楼梯图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: An elevator icon crossed out with a red X and a stairway icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 走楼梯，不乘电梯。

shots.scene: 阿杰想回实验室拿书包，被小研拉住
shots.prompt_en: The young male student turns back toward the lab for his backpack; the female graduate student holds his arm and shakes her head.
shots.narration: 出来了就别回头取东西。

shots.scene: 集合点上王老师拿着空白名单清点人数
shots.prompt_en: At an outdoor assembly point, the safety administrator counts students with a blank clipboard.
shots.narration: 到集合点报到，清点人数，按本校预案执行。

shots.section_title: 职业健康安全管理体系
shots.scene: 欣欣举起一本封面只有安全帽和心形图标的书
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank book whose cover shows only a hard hat icon and a heart icon.
shots.narration: 第四题：这套管理体系标准管什么？
overlay: 职业健康安全管理体系

shots.section_title: 职业健康安全管理体系
shots.scene: 四个选项气泡，其中“职业健康安全”亮起
shots.prompt_en: Four blank option bubbles; one bubble with a worker and heart icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是职业健康安全。

shots.section_title: 职业健康安全管理体系
shots.scene: 旧书被放进箱子，新书放上书架
shots.prompt_en: An old blank book is placed into an archive box while a new blank book is put on the shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 原题里的旧标准，已被新标准取代。

shots.section_title: 职业健康安全管理体系
shots.scene: 新书封面上一个循环箭头：计划、实施、检查、改进
shots.prompt_en: A blank book cover with a circular arrow divided into four segments with simple icons: a plan sheet, a gear, a magnifier and an upward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 核心是计划、实施、检查、改进的循环。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在三本厚书旁，书脊空白，配天平图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three thick blank law books with a scale of justice icon.
shots.narration: 在国内，还要遵守安全和职业健康法律。

shots.scene: 三级台阶：学校、学院、实验室图标
shots.prompt_en: Three steps with icons: a university building, a faculty building and a laboratory flask. No people.
shots.narration: 高校实行学校、学院、实验室三级管理。

shots.scene: 老周在实验室门口签字，阿杰拿着合格证书
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank form at the lab door while the young male student holds a blank training certificate.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人是第一责任人，培训合格才准入。

shots.scene: 王老师指着书本，旁边一个提示图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points to a blank rule book with a small reminder icon.
shots.narration: 具体条款，以现行文本和本校规定为准。

shots.scene: 地球图标和齿轮图标组合
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon combined with a gear icon and a leaf. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：EMS是什么意思？

shots.scene: 四个选项气泡，“环境管理体系”亮起
shots.prompt_en: Four blank option bubbles; the one with a globe and leaf icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是环境管理体系。

shots.scene: 工厂、实验楼、河流和树木，箭头表示减少排放
shots.prompt_en: A small factory, a laboratory building, a river and trees, with downward arrows on emission clouds. No people.
shots.narration: 它帮单位系统地减少对环境的影响。

shots.scene: 马路上一个敞开的检修井口，没有盖板和围挡
shots.prompt_en: An open manhole on a road with no cover and no barrier. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：没盖盖子的检修井，算什么？

shots.scene: 四个卡片：事件、未遂事件、不安全状态、不安全行为
shots.prompt_en: Four blank cards in a row with icons: a bang, a near-fall, a hazard triangle on an object and a person icon doing something wrong. No people.
shots.narration: 事件、未遂、不安全状态、不安全行为。

shots.scene: “物”的卡片亮起，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The card with a hazard triangle on an object glows with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是不安全状态，问题出在物和环境上。

shots.scene: 一个人跨过围栏的图标，标为不安全行为
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person stepping over a barrier, marked with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 人做错了动作，才叫不安全行为。

shots.scene: 实验室地面一个打开的地沟盖板，小研放上围挡
shots.prompt_en: In a laboratory, an open floor drain cover; the female graduate student places a yellow warning barrier around it.
shots.narration: 实验室里敞开的盖板、乱拉的线，都要及时处理。

shots.scene: 心形图标和肺部图标
shots.prompt_en: A heart icon next to a pair of lungs icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：CPR是什么？

shots.scene: 四个选项气泡，“心肺复苏”亮起
shots.prompt_en: Four blank option bubbles; the one with a heart and lungs icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是心肺复苏。

shots.scene: 训练用假人和按压手势图标
shots.prompt_en: A CPR training manikin on the floor with a hand-compression icon above its chest. No people.
shots.narration: 心跳呼吸停止时，用它维持生命。

shots.scene: 小研在培训教室里对着假人练习，老师在旁指导
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student practices on a CPR training manikin in a classroom while an instructor watches.
shots.narration: 心肺复苏要经过正规培训才能做好。

shots.scene: 墙上的自动体外除颤器箱子，绿色标志
shots.prompt_en: An AED cabinet on a corridor wall with a green heart and lightning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 记住楼里除颤器放在哪儿。

shots.scene: 阿杰拨打电话，屏幕上120
shots.prompt_en: The young male student makes an urgent phone call on a mobile phone.
shots.narration: 有人倒下，马上打120。

shots.scene: 小研向老周报告，老周拿起电话
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the older man, who picks up a phone at once.
shots.narration: 同时报告实验室负责人和学院。

shots.scene: 四个图标：核电站冷却塔、烟囱电厂、风车、闪电
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a nuclear cooling tower, a coal power plant chimney, a wind turbine and a lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：哪种发电方式对环境最友好？

shots.scene: 风车图标亮起，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The wind turbine icon glows with a green check mark; green hills around it. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是风能，可再生、不冒烟。

shots.scene: 烟囱冒黑烟打叉，太阳能板和水电站图标浮现
shots.prompt_en: A smoking chimney crossed out with a red X, while solar panel and hydropower dam icons appear. No people.
shots.narration: 太阳能、水能也是清洁能源。

shots.scene: 实验室里小研关掉空转的仪器和灯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches off idle equipment and the lights in an empty lab at the end of the day.
shots.narration: 实验室里随手关掉空转的设备，也算环保。

shots.scene: 红色三角形，三条边上分别是火焰、木块、空气图标
shots.prompt_en: A red triangle with icons on its three sides: a flame, a block of wood and an air swirl. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：火三角由哪三样组成？

shots.scene: 三角形三边亮起
shots.prompt_en: The three sides of the triangle light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 热、可燃物、氧气，三样凑齐才着火。

shots.scene: 拿掉一条边，火焰熄灭
shots.prompt_en: One side of the triangle is pulled away and the flame in the middle goes out. No people.
shots.narration: 拿走任意一样，火就灭了。

shots.scene: 实验台上溶剂瓶远离加热板
shots.prompt_en: On a lab bench, solvent bottles are moved far away from a hot plate. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里，溶剂要远离热源。

shots.scene: 司机打哈欠，眼皮下垂，车灯在夜里
shots.prompt_en: A tired driver yawns at night with drooping eyelids, headlights shining on a dark road.
shots.narration: 第十题：开车越来越迷糊，直到睡着。

shots.scene: 四个选项气泡，“疲劳”亮起，配电量低的电池图标
shots.prompt_en: Four blank option bubbles; the one with a low battery icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 这叫疲劳，不是头痛也不是醉酒。

shots.scene: 司机把车停进服务区休息
shots.prompt_en: A car parks at a highway rest area and the driver stretches outside.
shots.narration: 犯困就停车休息，别硬撑。

shots.scene: 深夜实验室里阿杰揉眼睛，钟表指向凌晨
shots.prompt_en: Late at night, the young male student rubs his eyes at a lab bench; a wall clock shows a very late hour.
shots.narration: 做实验也会疲劳，熬夜最容易出错。

shots.scene: 日历图标上排好实验时段，危险实验不安排在深夜
shots.prompt_en: A blank calendar with time blocks planned; a moon icon next to a hazard triangle is crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 合理排时间，危险实验别在疲惫时做。

shots.scene: 小研调整座椅高度，手臂与台面平齐，脚踩实地面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student adjusts her chair height at a lab bench so her forearms are level with the bench and feet rest flat.
shots.narration: 座椅和台面调到合适高度。

shots.scene: 阿杰长时间连续按移液器，手腕红色疼痛图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student presses a pipette repeatedly; a red pain icon glows on his wrist.
shots.narration: 长时间重复移液，手腕会劳损。

shots.scene: 小研换手、活动手腕，旁边计时器图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stretches her wrists and changes hands, with a small timer icon beside her.
shots.narration: 定时休息、活动手腕，变换姿势。

shots.scene: 显示器与眼睛平齐，人坐直
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sits upright at a computer with the monitor at eye level.
shots.narration: 屏幕与视线齐平，别长时间低头。

shots.scene: 一杯清水，旁边四个选项气泡
shots.prompt_en: A clear glass of water with four blank option bubbles around it. No people.
shots.narration: 第十一题：能直接喝的水叫什么？

shots.scene: 水杯配绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The glass of water with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 叫饮用水，别和“便携”这个词混淆。

shots.scene: 实验室洗瓶、纯水瓶旁边一个杯子图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A lab wash bottle and a pure water container, with a drinking cup icon crossed out next to them. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室的纯水和自来水龙头，都不能喝。

shots.scene: 走廊的饮水区，学生在实验室外喝水
shots.prompt_en: Students drink water at a drinking station in a corridor outside the laboratory.
shots.narration: 实验室里不饮食，喝水到室外。

shots.scene: 一个人躺在地上，脸色苍白，旁边心脏和氧气图标变暗
shots.prompt_en: A pale person lying on the floor; a heart icon and an oxygen icon beside him fade.
shots.narration: 第十二题：休克时身体发生什么？

shots.scene: 氧气图标向下箭头
shots.prompt_en: An oxygen molecule icon with a downward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是体内供氧减少。

shots.scene: 血管图标中血流变弱，器官图标变灰
shots.prompt_en: A simple blood vessel icon with weak flow, and organ icons turning gray. No people.
shots.narration: 血液循环不足，器官就会缺氧。

shots.scene: 阿杰让伤员平躺，盖上外套，同时打电话
shots.prompt_en: The young male student lays an injured person flat, covers him with a jacket and makes a phone call.
shots.narration: 让人平躺保暖，马上打120。

shots.scene: 地球图标，周围温度计、臭氧层破洞、绿叶循环图标
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon surrounded by a rising thermometer, a hole in a protective layer and a green leaf cycle. No people.
shots.narration: 第十三题：全球环保关注哪些问题？

shots.scene: 三个图标一起打勾
shots.prompt_en: All three icons receive green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 变暖、臭氧层、可持续发展，都要关注。

shots.scene: 实验室节约试剂、少用一次性用品
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student measures a small amount of reagent and uses a reusable glass container instead of disposable plastic.
shots.narration: 实验室少用多余试剂，就是出一份力。

shots.scene: 一辆车停在检测线上，排气管接着检测仪
shots.prompt_en: A car on an inspection line with an emission testing probe attached to its exhaust pipe. No people.
shots.narration: 第十四题：汽车尾气要不要检验？

shots.scene: 检测合格的绿勾，旁边一辆冒黑烟的车打叉
shots.prompt_en: A green check next to a clean car, and a car with black smoke crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 原题讲国外的污染受控证明。

shots.scene: 空白的检验合格单
shots.prompt_en: A blank inspection certificate with a green check stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 国内机动车也要定期做排放检验。

shots.scene: 微波炉图标，内部有波纹线
shots.prompt_en: A microwave oven icon with wavy lines inside. No people.
shots.narration: 第十五题：微波炉产生什么波？

shots.scene: 波纹线亮起，配电磁波图标
shots.prompt_en: The wavy lines glow, with an electromagnetic wave icon. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是电磁波，微波就是一种电磁波。

shots.scene: 实验室微波炉贴着“禁止食品”图标，旁边餐盒打叉
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory microwave oven with a no-food pictogram on its door and a lunch box crossed out beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室的微波炉，绝不能热饭菜。

shots.scene: 密封的瓶子放进微波炉的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tightly sealed bottle going into a microwave oven, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 也不能加热密封容器和金属。

shots.scene: 电器外壳带电的闪电图标，一只手触碰
shots.prompt_en: An appliance casing with a lightning icon and a hand reaching to touch it. No people.
shots.narration: 第十六题：电器没做什么，容易触电？

shots.scene: 接地符号亮起
shots.prompt_en: An electrical grounding symbol lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是接地。

shots.scene: 电流沿接地线流入大地，箭头
shots.prompt_en: Arrows show current flowing from an appliance casing through a ground wire into the earth. No people.
shots.narration: 漏电时，电流从地线走，不从人身上过。

shots.scene: 三孔插座和三脚插头，配绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A three-hole wall socket and a three-pin plug with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 仪器用三孔插座，地线不能断。

shots.scene: 插线板串接插线板打叉
shots.prompt_en: A power strip plugged into another power strip, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不私拉电线，不把插线板串着用。

shots.scene: 配电箱里漏电保护开关，老李按试验按钮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses the test button on a residual current circuit breaker in a distribution box.
shots.narration: 漏电保护要定期试验。

shots.scene: 湿手触碰插头的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wet hand touching a plug, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 湿手不碰电器，线坏了报修别自己接。

shots.scene: 三个循环箭头，分别是减量、再利用、再循环图标
shots.prompt_en: Three curved arrows forming a cycle, each with an icon: a shrinking box, a refilled bottle and a recycling symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 第十七题：废物管理的3R是什么？

shots.scene: 三个箭头依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The three arrows light up one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 减量、再利用、再循环。

shots.scene: 实验室按需领用试剂，小瓶分装
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes only a small labeled bottle of reagent from storage, leaving the large bottle on the shelf.
shots.narration: 实验室先从减量做起，按需领用。

shots.scene: 几个分类废物桶：化学废液、锐器盒、感染性废物袋
shots.prompt_en: Several separate waste containers in a lab: a chemical waste carboy, a sharps box and a biohazard waste bag holder. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室废物要分类收集。

shots.scene: 倒进水槽的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of liquid being poured into a sink drain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 危险废物不能倒下水道。

shots.scene: 王老师在交接单上签字，转运车停在门口
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank handover form while a waste collection cart waits at the door.
shots.narration: 贴好标签登记，交有资质的单位处置。

shots.section_title: 空调不含消耗臭氧层物质
shots.scene: 空调外机图标，旁边四个部件图标
shots.prompt_en: An air conditioner outdoor unit icon with four component icons around it: a filter, a compressor, a gas cloud and a coil. No people.
shots.narration: 第十八题：空调里不应含有什么？
overlay: 空调不含消耗臭氧层物质

shots.section_title: 空调不含消耗臭氧层物质
shots.scene: 气体云图标亮起并打叉，臭氧层破洞图标
shots.prompt_en: The gas cloud icon is crossed out with a red X next to an icon of a hole in the ozone layer. No people.
shots.narration: 消耗臭氧层的物质，不该再用。

shots.section_title: 空调不含消耗臭氧层物质
shots.scene: 滤网、压缩机、冷凝器图标打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The filter, compressor and coil icons get green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 滤网、压缩机、冷凝器都是正常部件。

shots.section_title: 空调不含消耗臭氧层物质
shots.scene: 冰箱和制冷设备报废时，老李联系回收单位
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tags an old refrigerator for professional recycling and makes a phone call.
shots.narration: 旧冰箱、空调报废，交专业单位回收。

shots.scene: 医院图标，四个选项：病理实验室、X光机、焚烧炉、血库
shots.prompt_en: A hospital icon with four option icons: a microscope, an X-ray machine, an incinerator and a blood bag. No people.
shots.narration: 第十九题：医院用什么处置医疗废物？

shots.scene: 焚烧炉图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: The incinerator icon glows. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是焚烧炉，高温能消灭病原体。

shots.scene: 黄色医疗废物袋装车，运往集中处置中心
shots.prompt_en: Yellow biohazard waste bags are loaded onto a closed collection truck heading to a central disposal facility. No people.
shots.narration: 国内由有资质的集中处置单位处理。

shots.scene: 实验室里自行焚烧的图标打叉，混入生活垃圾的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: burning waste in a lab and throwing a biohazard bag into a household trash bin. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室不能自己烧，也不能混进生活垃圾。

shots.section_title: 化学品安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 一份空白的多页文件，封面有化学瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank multi-page document with a chemical bottle icon on the cover. No people.
shots.narration: 第二十题：MSDS是什么？
overlay: 化学品安全技术说明书

shots.section_title: 化学品安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 选项气泡中“安全数据表”亮起
shots.prompt_en: Four blank option bubbles; the one with a document and shield icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是物质安全数据表。

shots.section_title: 化学品安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 文件封面换成新的名称图标SDS
shots.prompt_en: The document cover changes to a newer version with a simple shield and bottle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 现在通称SDS，化学品安全技术说明书。

shots.scene: 小研在电脑前翻看空白的说明书页面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank safety data sheet on a computer screen before an experiment.
shots.narration: 用新试剂前，先读它的说明书。

shots.scene: 说明书上几个图标：火焰、骷髅、急救十字、灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A blank data sheet with icons: a flame, a skull, a first aid cross and a fire extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 危害、防护、急救、灭火，里面都有。

shots.scene: 试剂瓶标签上的红边菱形象形图
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle with a blank label showing red-bordered diamond hazard pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶上的安全标签和象形图也要看懂。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前，白板上四队分数柱
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard showing four score bars of different heights.
shots.narration: 竞赛结束，我们来回顾一下。

shots.scene: 图标：一氧化碳、警铃、心肺、火三角
shots.prompt_en: Icons in a row: a gas molecule with a skull, an alarm bell, a heart with lungs and a fire triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 有毒气体、立即疏散、心肺复苏、火三角。

shots.scene: 图标：电池低电量、接地符号、分类垃圾桶、说明书
shots.prompt_en: Icons in a row: a low battery, a grounding symbol, sorted waste bins and a safety data sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 防疲劳、要接地、废物分类、看说明书。

shots.scene: 阿杰在答题卡上写出高分，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds up an answer card with many green ticks and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：原来每道题都和实验室有关。

shots.scene: 王老师在门口贴出下次竞赛的空白海报
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator pins a new blank quiz poster on a notice board.
shots.narration: 具体规定，以现行文本和本校制度为准。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起奖杯，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a small trophy and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 安全知识天天学，下次竞赛见！
